2608.06015.title: ProDVI: Programmatic Dynamics Priors for Value Network Initialization
2608.06015.paper_summary: Deep Reinforcement Learning (RL) is notoriously sample inefficient. One contributing factor is that RL agents are typically initialized from scratch, forcing them to acquire task-relevant knowledge through online interaction. Existing approaches obtain informative initializations through pre-collected datasets, high-fidelity simulators, or meta-learning over related tasks, but these prerequisites may be difficult to access or even unavailable. In this paper, we propose Programmatic Dynamics Priors for Value Network Initialization (ProDVI), a framework that leverages the commonsense and domain knowledge encoded in large language models to initialize RL agents without relying on these resources. Specifically, ProDVI prompts a code-generating language model to produce executable Python functions that encode coarse hypotheses about environment dynamics. These functions are then used to generate synthetic transitions. Based on these transitions, we construct an auxiliary dynamics prediction objective to pretrain the state-action encoder of the value network in an actor-critic framework. The learned representation provides dynamics-aware inductive biases before online RL begins. Importantly, the generated programs are used only for representation pretraining and are not required to faithfully simulate the target environment. While the generated programs may be inaccurate, their induced initialization can be corrected through online learning from real transitions and rewards. Experiments on OpenAI Gym and DeepMind Control Suite tasks show that ProDVI can effectively improve the sample efficiency of model-free RL algorithms.
2608.06015.paper_summary_zh: 深度強化學習（RL）以樣本效率低下而聞名。造成這一問題的因素之一是，RL代理通常是從零開始初始化，迫使它們通過在線互動獲取與任務相關的知識。現有的方法通過預先收集的數據集、高保真模擬器或在相關任務上的元學習來獲得有用的初始化，但這些前提條件可能難以獲得，甚至無法獲得。在本文中，我們提出了用於價值網絡初始化的程序動態先驗（ProDVI），這是一個利用大型語言模型中編碼的常識和領域知識來初始化RL代理的框架，而無需依賴這些資源。具體而言，ProDVI提示一個生成代碼的語言模型來產生可執行的Python函數，這些函數編碼了有關環境動態的粗略假設。然後，這些函數用於生成合成過渡。基於這些過渡，我們構建了一個輔助動態預測目標，以在演員-評論家框架中預訓練價值網絡的狀態-行動編碼器。學習到的表示在在線RL開始之前提供了動態感知的歸納偏見。重要的是，生成的程序僅用於表示預訓練，並不要求忠實地模擬目標環境。雖然生成的程序可能不準確，但其引入的初始化可以通過從真實過渡和獎勵中進行在線學習來進行修正。在OpenAI Gym和DeepMind Control Suite任務上的實驗表明，ProDVI可以有效提高無模型RL算法的樣本效率。
